name: Shinjou Miki
source:
She is the same age as the main character. She has excellent grades, is also a good cook with a good personality.

She is a brilliant and talented woman, but when it comes to Shuuichi, she often goes off the rails.

She is not good at scary stories and sometimes faints just from the mention of it. She is a virgin.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/momo_hina/tappunbeach/index.html]official site[/url]]
